newsitem.title: USA: Celtrix to start Phase 2 trials.
newsitem.headline: Celtrix to start Phase 2 trials.

text.p: Celtrix Pharmaceuticals Inc plans to begin two separate Phase Two studies this year of its SomatoKine complex in indications to treat hip fractures and severe burns, President Andreas Sommer said.

The company will also seek corporate partnerships to help it develop additional applications of SomatoKine as a treatment for severe osteoporosis and for protein wasting diseases that afflict AIDS and cancer patients, among others, Sommer told a Hambrecht and Quist Healthcare Conference here.
To date, trials of SomatoKline have shown it restores lost bone mass in people with osteoporosis and muscle mass in burn patients.
"We think this will result in a significant reduction of hospital costs," Sommer said.
